rationale: design-import-refactor: generic change landed in Pulp per owner decision 2026-10-04; Vellum inherits (see inheritance ledger); MeterSource::publish now fills the triple-buffer slot in place (one copy instead of two) and PublishCounter uses a relaxed load and store instead of an atomic read-modify-write, which is correct under the existing single-writer contract. The TripleBuffer contract is unchanged for consumers and is now documented explicitly. Pulp's retained UI kernel has not adopted a Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging, or source-authority boundary moves.
